body:
Tier 4 reward in scripts/rl_env_packet.py (REWARD_MOVEMENT_PER_TICK / REWARD_BUTTON_PRESS_PER_TICK, deadzone-gated) so the RL agent gets a small, honest bonus for real movement/button presses without overpowering the outcome/positional/survival tiers. 35 reward tests pass. BRAWLPIT commit cd37ba5.
